Normalize each channel independently per sample.

Normalizes every channel of every sample over its height and width (PyTorch InstanceNorm2d); the channel count comes from the layer before it.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Normalization](../categories/normalization.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Search words | instancenorm, instance normalization, style transfer, channels |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Input** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Image feature map [H, W, C] per sample. |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Output** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Normalized feature map, same shape. |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Normalization | Channels | `num_features` | Integer | `64` | `1-1048576` | The run | Expected input channel count C. Required. |
| Normalization | Epsilon | `eps` | Number | `1e-5` | `0.000000001-1.0` | The run | Positive numerical-stability term. Required. Advanced. |
| Normalization | Affine | `affine` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Learn one scale and bias per channel. Advanced. |
| Fine-tuning | Frozen | `frozen` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Keeps this layer's weights as they are while the rest of the model trains: no gradient step, no weight decay, no optimizer memory. Use it on layers that start from a weights file (fine-tuning), then turn it off to train them too. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a layer of the model: compiled as a trainable instance-normalisation layer |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Usage

Equivalent to GroupNorm with num_groups = num_channels.
